name: Chable Yucatan
positioning: Chable Yucatan, a wellness resort in the Mayan jungle of Chochola near Merida, combining a restored historic hacienda with private villas and a spa centered on a natural cenote
best_for: Travelers looking for tranquility and wellness-focused stays
Guests who want a private terrace and pool with their accommodation

facts.text: Chable Yucatan is located in the Mayan jungle of Chochola, near Merida, Mexico.
The resort is about 40 km (25 miles) from Merida.
The drive from Merida International Airport takes approximately 45 to 50 minutes.
Wellness programs include personalized treatments, yoga, meditation and traditional Mayan healing practices.
Casitas have king-size beds, seating areas, indoor and outdoor showers and oversized bathrooms.
Interiors feature natural stone floors, locally crafted textiles and hand-carved wooden furnishings.
Dining venues focus on contemporary Mexican cuisine using local and seasonal ingredients.
Guests can enjoy cycling, nature walks and excursions to cenotes and nearby Mayan archaeological sites.
Nearby attractions include Merida, Uxmal and cenotes.
Families are welcome and the resort has a Kids Club.
Private airport transfers can be arranged.

highlights.text: The spa is centered around a natural cenote, a sacred freshwater sinkhole in Mayan culture.
The resort combines a restored historic hacienda with private villas.
The Royal Villa sits within the former hacienda's walls.
The rooms were designed by Mexican interior designer Paulina Moran using locally sourced materials.
All accommodations include outdoor space with a private terrace and pool.

considerations.text: The resort is not all-inclusive; guests select dining, wellness and activity experiences individually.
The resort says the best time to visit is November to April, when the weather is dry.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires advance planning for excursions.
